title: Irrevocable infinite token approval with no deregistration mechanism
description: type(uint256).max approval granted at registration, never revocable. No deregister function. Pausing doesn't revoke. Creates persistent attack surface.
impact: Permanently approved dispatchers retain ability to drain tokens even when paused
recommendation: Add deregisterDispatcher() that revokes approval, or approve only per-dispatch amount
root_cause: Irrevocable infinite approval with no deregistration mechanism
